classes.name: Enforcer
classes.description: Front-line fighter trained to hold ground. Trades mobility for raw staying power and straightforward strikes.

classes.name: Vanguard
classes.description: Shield-first advance of the Enforcer. Specializes in absorbing pressure so the line behind them never breaks.

classes.name: Dreadnought
classes.description: Living siege engine. Enormous health and armor let a Dreadnought walk through volleys that would drop a squad.

classes.name: Sentinel
classes.description: Immovable guardian. Almost nothing gets past a Sentinel's guard, at the cost of limited offense.

classes.name: Berserker
classes.description: Enforcer who abandons defense for fury. Hits harder the longer a fight lasts, and bleeds for it.

classes.name: Warlord
classes.description: Battlefield tyrant. Turns personal rage into commanding presence and crushing weapon swings.

classes.name: Ravager
classes.description: Bleeding-edge berserker. Chains wounds and keeps moving so the target never gets a clean recovery.

classes.name: Dragoon
classes.description: Polearm specialist who mixes Enforcer weight with sudden bursts of speed.

classes.name: Skyreaver
classes.description: Aerial lancer. Closes distance in a leap and leaves the target exposed before they can reset.

classes.name: Void Lancer
classes.description: Perception-tuned lancer who aims at weak points and pierces through cover.

classes.name: Strider
classes.description: Light fighter built on footwork and awareness. Survives by not being where the blow lands.

classes.name: Assassin
classes.description: Close-range killer. Opens from a blind angle and finishes before the target turns.

classes.name: Shadowblade
classes.description: Darkness duelist. Stacks critical windows and vanishes between exchanges.

classes.name: Phantom
classes.description: Misdirection specialist. Reads intent, then punishes the swing that was never going to land.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: Tracker and marksman. Reads terrain, wind, and prey before the first shot.

classes.name: BeastExpert
classes.description: Ranger who fights with a bonded beast. Shares senses and splits the enemy's attention.

classes.name: Sniper Elite
classes.description: Extreme-range shooter. One clean shot is worth more than a magazine of panic fire.

classes.name: Gunslinger
classes.description: Hip-fire specialist. Perception and agility keep the cylinder turning and the feet moving.

classes.name: Desperado
classes.description: Duelist of the open street. Wins by drawing first and refusing to stand still.

classes.name: Tech-Drifter
classes.description: Gunhand wired into scavenged tech. Mixes ballistics with gadgets and short-range hacks.

classes.name: Channeler
classes.description: Conduit for ambient power. Perception opens the channel; mana keeps it stable.

classes.name: Mystic
classes.description: Pure channeler. Deepens perception until spells land with very little waste.

classes.name: Archon
classes.description: High conduit. Enormous mana and perception make an Archon the center of any ritual fight.

classes.name: Chronomancer
classes.description: Time-bent mystic. Steals beats from the turn order and spends them as extra actions.

classes.name: Warpriest
classes.description: Channeler who takes the oath onto the front line. Faith, steel, and a smaller mana pool.

classes.name: Templar
classes.description: Armored warpriest. Holds consecrated ground and keeps allies standing inside it.

classes.name: Arbiter
classes.description: Judgment caster. Weighs a target and spends mana to enforce the verdict.

classes.name: Summoner
classes.description: Channeler who spends mana to call something else into the fight.

classes.name: Void Caller
classes.description: Summoner of rifts. Pulls hostile entities from elsewhere and points them at a target.

classes.name: Golemancer
classes.description: Summoner of constructs. Builds a body that soaks damage the caster cannot.

classes.name: Machinist
classes.description: Hands-on tinkerer. Perception finds the fault; a tool or a shot exploits it.

classes.name: Artificer
classes.description: Device specialist. Turns scavenged parts into repeatable combat tools.

classes.name: Mecha Pilot
classes.description: Artificer in a frame. The suit carries the hp and the pilot carries the targeting.

classes.name: Cyber-Architect
classes.description: Systems builder. Raises temporary structures and defensive grids mid-fight.

classes.name: Saboteur
classes.description: Machinist who breaks things on purpose. Fast hands, planted charges, cut lines.

classes.name: Demolitionist
classes.description: Charge specialist. Shapes blasts so the kill zone is intentional, not accidental.

classes.name: Netrunner
classes.description: Intrusion specialist. Burns mana-like focus to hijack devices and living systems alike.

classes.name: Alchemist
classes.description: Compound specialist. Mixes reagents into effects the body cannot ignore.

classes.name: Bio-Engineer
classes.description: Alchemist of living tissue. Rewrites a wound into a recovery, or a recovery into a weapon.

classes.name: Plague Spreader
classes.description: Weaponized chemist. Seeds a status and lets the fight do the rest of the work.

classes.name: Iron Colossus
classes.description: Dreadnought who stopped being a soldier and became a wall. Absorbs siege fire and answers with a step that shakes the line.

classes.name: Siegebreaker
classes.description: Dreadnought turned into a ram. Still absurdly hard to drop, but built to open gates, shields, and formations.

classes.name: Aegis Ward
classes.description: Sentinel whose guard extends past their own body. Plants a ward and makes the space behind it expensive to enter.

classes.name: Bulwark
classes.description: Personal fortress. Gives up reach for a guard stance that barely moves, even under ultimates.

classes.name: Conqueror
classes.description: Warlord who fights as a banner. Personal damage is high, and nearby allies hit harder while the Conqueror is standing.

classes.name: Blood Tyrant
classes.description: Warlord who spends their own blood as fuel. Peak single-target brutality with almost no safety margin.

classes.name: Gorefiend
classes.description: Ravager obsessed with open wounds. Every hit extends a bleed and punishes anyone already leaking.

classes.name: Rampager
classes.description: Ravager who never resets. Chains dashes through a pack and leaves a trail of half-finished kills.

classes.name: Stormlancer
classes.description: Skyreaver who rides the fall. Leap, impact, and a shock that staggers everyone near the landing.

classes.name: Skydancer
classes.description: Skyreaver who treats the air as cover. Evades more than they tank, and punishes the whiff.

classes.name: Riftpiercer
classes.description: Void Lancer who opens a short rift on the thrust. The hit ignores a slice of defense and arrives early.

classes.name: Eclipse Lancer
classes.description: Void Lancer who blacks out a target's read. Marks a weak point, then blinds the window they needed to dodge.

classes.name: Night Reaper
classes.description: Shadowblade who only commits when the target is isolated. Execute windows are short and absolute.

classes.name: Umbral Duelist
classes.description: Shadowblade who duels in the dark. Counters the next swing and answers from the off-hand.

classes.name: Wraith
classes.description: Phantom who slips out of the hitbox. A missed attack against a Wraith is often the last clean action the attacker gets.

classes.name: Mirage
classes.description: Phantom who fights with copies. The real body is rarely the one the enemy committed to.

classes.name: Pack Alpha
classes.description: Beastmaster who leads more than one bond. The pack splits focus and the Alpha finishes whatever is marked.

classes.name: Wildbound
classes.description: Beastmaster who shares a body-sense with the beast. Moves as one unit and covers the angles the other cannot.

classes.name: Deadeye
classes.description: Sniper Elite at the edge of the map. Holds a shot until the weak point is certain, then ends the exchange.

classes.name: Ghost Marksman
classes.description: Sniper Elite who relocates after every shot. The second round never comes from the same nest.

classes.name: Outlaw King
classes.description: Desperado who owns the street. Fan-fire and a presence that makes allies braver and targets sloppier.

classes.name: Quickdraw Saint
classes.description: Desperado whose draw is a ritual. Wins the first frame of a duel and rarely needs a third shot.

classes.name: Chrome Gunner
classes.description: Tech-Drifter bolted into a heavier rig. Smart rounds, heat sinks, and a gun that does not jam when the fight gets ugly.

classes.name: Circuit Cowboy
classes.description: Tech-Drifter who hacks between shots. A tagged enemy fights with one system already lying to them.

classes.name: Ascendant
classes.description: Archon who stopped channeling and started overflowing. Spells are larger, longer, and much more expensive.

classes.name: Oracle Prime
classes.description: Archon who reads the fight before it resolves. Less raw mana, more information, and spells that land on the future position.

classes.name: Timeweaver
classes.description: Chronomancer who braids short loops. Rewinds a mistake, or forces an enemy to repeat a bad beat.

classes.name: Paradox
classes.description: Chronomancer who breaks causality on purpose. Acts twice in a window where everyone else acts once.

classes.name: Crusader
classes.description: Templar on the offensive oath. Consecrated strikes that heal a sliver of the damage they deal.

classes.name: Oathkeeper
classes.description: Templar who holds the vow. Intercepts a blow meant for an ally and answers with a ward, not a chase.

classes.name: Judicator
classes.description: Arbiter who delivers sentence in an area. Guilt is a status, and the next spell spends it.

classes.name: Inquisitor
classes.description: Arbiter who questions with a blade. Mixes mana verdicts with melee so a silenced caster still dies.

classes.name: Abyss Herald
classes.description: Void Caller who keeps the rift open. Summons last longer and arrive already hostile to the marked target.

classes.name: Riftbinder
classes.description: Void Caller who anchors the tear to their own body. Fewer summons, harder to dispel, and a personal shield from the rift.

classes.name: Titanforger
classes.description: Golemancer of siege constructs. The golem is a second tank, and the caster hides in its shadow.

classes.name: Runesmith
classes.description: Golemancer who writes combat into the construct. Runes swap the golem between guard, slam, and pulse.

classes.name: Titan Pilot
classes.description: Mecha Pilot in a heavy frame. Slow to turn, brutal when the weapon system is online.

classes.name: Ace Frame
classes.description: Mecha Pilot in a light frame. Boosts, lock-on, and a cockpit that rewards the pilot who never stops moving.

classes.name: Gridmind
classes.description: Cyber-Architect who thinks in networks. Turrets, walls, and hacks share a single grid and buff each other.

classes.name: Nexus Engineer
classes.description: Cyber-Architect who builds a personal nexus. The node tanks, repairs devices, and punishes anyone who breaks a link.

classes.name: Bombardier
classes.description: Demolitionist of long arcs. Lobs shaped charges that detonate on a timer or on contact.

classes.name: Blastmaster
classes.description: Demolitionist who sculpts the blast. Smaller radius, higher pressure, and a knockback that opens the next charge.

classes.name: Ghost Protocol
classes.description: Netrunner who is never on the node they just touched. Hacks, relocates, and leaves a trace that lies.

classes.name: Daemon King
classes.description: Netrunner who installs a daemon and lets it work. Damage, silence, and stolen cooldowns tick without a second cast.

classes.name: Geneweaver
classes.description: Bio-Engineer who edits mid-fight. A splice can close a wound or force a mutation the target did not consent to.

classes.name: Vitaforge
classes.description: Bio-Engineer of living armor. Grows plates, shares regen, and turns the squad into a harder organism.

classes.name: Pestilence
classes.description: Plague Spreader whose strain jumps. One application becomes a cloud, then a second target, then the pack.

classes.name: Blightlord
classes.description: Plague Spreader who drinks their own work. Deals blight damage and converts a share of it into personal sustain.

quests.title: The Line We Keep
quests.description: Five levels of field work. Good. Now make it count for someone else. Feral roots have closed the garden path our ration crews use. I will not ask for trophies; I want that route safe. Keep your breathing steady, finish the drill, and return to me. Then we choose the role you can actually sustain. Defeat Feral Rootling ×5 in Aethel Gardens. Return to Instructor Kael at Nexus Core to receive Civic Oath Seal and choose your Base class.

objectives.description: Defeat Feral Rootling ×5 in Aethel Gardens.

quests.title: A Route for Everyone
quests.description: Kael taught you to hold a line. I need you to move one. The outer-ring wardens are driving supply crews back into the broken quarter. Clear a passage without treating every ruin as expendable. A specialist earns trust when the next crew can follow them home. Defeat Cradle Fragment Beast ×8 in Cradle Outer Ring. Defeat Cradle Warden ×2 in Cradle Outer Ring. Return to Field Captain Ilyra at Nexus Core to receive Routekeeper Warrant and choose your Advance class.

objectives.description: Defeat Cradle Fragment Beast ×8 in Cradle Outer Ring.
Defeat Cradle Warden ×2 in Cradle Outer Ring.

quests.title: Protocol Under Pressure
quests.description: The stabilization protocol assumes obedient sentinels. Our sentinels have stopped obeying. I need evidence that you can respond when the procedure fails: remove the hostile units inside the exclusion zone. Report what the ledger records, not what you wish happened. Defeat Cradle Sentinel ×10 in Inner Cradle Exclusion. Defeat Cradle Purifier ×4 in Inner Cradle Exclusion. Return to Inspector Soren at Nexus Core to receive Cradle Stabilization Charter and choose your Expert class.

objectives.description: Defeat Cradle Sentinel ×10 in Inner Cradle Exclusion.
Defeat Cradle Purifier ×4 in Inner Cradle Exclusion.

quests.title: The Last Civilian Convoy
quests.description: There is one convoy left inside the exclusion zone. Command calls the route unrecoverable. I have their names here. Break the beasts controlling that corridor and bring your report to me. Mastery means accepting responsibility when the easy order is to abandon people. Defeat Arcane Rift Beast ×16 in Inner Cradle Exclusion. Defeat Cradle Void Titanling ×6 in Inner Cradle Exclusion. Return to Marshal Elian at Nexus Core to receive Concordium Steward Sigil and choose your Master class.

objectives.description: Defeat Arcane Rift Beast ×16 in Inner Cradle Exclusion.
Defeat Cradle Void Titanling ×6 in Inner Cradle Exclusion.

quests.title: An Observation Before an Oath
quests.description: A class is a hypothesis about what you might become. Do not mistake it for proof. Wild Mushrooms are interrupting our slope readings; confront them and let the ledger record the results. Return with observations. I can teach a promising mind. I cannot teach a mind that invents its evidence. Defeat Wild Mushroom ×5 in Crystal Slope. Return to Archsage Myr at Observatory Spire to receive Resonance Thesis Prism and choose your Base class.

objectives.description: Defeat Wild Mushroom ×5 in Crystal Slope.

quests.title: The Echo That Answers
quests.description: The cavern echoes have begun answering signals nobody transmitted. My last team withdrew, correctly. Establish a safe baseline against the bats and the resonant echoes before I send anyone back. Curiosity should widen our understanding, not empty our chairs. Defeat Resonance Bat ×8 in Resonance Caverns. Defeat Resonance Echo ×2 in Resonance Caverns. Return to Resonant Scholar Eira at Observatory Spire to receive Echo Calibration Lens and choose your Advance class.

objectives.description: Defeat Resonance Bat ×8 in Resonance Caverns.
Defeat Resonance Echo ×2 in Resonance Caverns.

quests.title: A Hypothesis with Teeth
quests.description: The peak guardians respond differently to each pulse. Your task is not to declare them understood; it is to stop the hostile pattern long enough for our instruments to survive. Bring a complete field record. I will challenge every conclusion you cannot support. Defeat Shard Pulse Sentinel ×10 in Shard Pulse Peak. Defeat Shard Pulse Guardian ×4 in Shard Pulse Peak. Return to Examiner Thalen at Observatory Spire to receive Peer Witness Crystal and choose your Expert class.

objectives.description: Defeat Shard Pulse Sentinel ×10 in Shard Pulse Peak.
Defeat Shard Pulse Guardian ×4 in Shard Pulse Peak.

quests.title: Knowledge Worth Returning With
quests.description: We could publish a triumph by sacrificing the next expedition. I refuse. Contain the peak's guardians and tyrants so that discovery can continue without another missing team. A master leaves knowledge others can test, and a path by which they can return. Defeat Shard Pulse Guardian ×16 in Shard Pulse Peak. Defeat Shard Pulse Tyrant ×6 in Shard Pulse Peak. Return to First Archivist Neris at Observatory Spire to receive Arcanum Living Codex and choose your Master class.

objectives.description: Defeat Shard Pulse Guardian ×16 in Shard Pulse Peak.
Defeat Shard Pulse Tyrant ×6 in Shard Pulse Peak.

quests.title: Steel Before Rank
quests.description: You have survived long enough to train properly. Scrap drones are tearing up the recovery lanes. Shut them down. No borrowed commendation, no purchased rank. Finish the work, return to Bastion, and I will put a tempered rivet in your hand. What you do next is your choice. Defeat Scrap Drone ×5 in Scrap Field. Return to War Marshal Drax at Bastion Core to receive Tempered Service Rivet and choose your Base class.

objectives.description: Defeat Scrap Drone ×5 in Scrap Field.

quests.title: Keep the Supply Line
quests.description: A brilliant fighter with an empty supply wagon is an expensive corpse. The graveyard machines are stopping our salvage crews. Clear the wreckers and their sentinel escorts. I want usable lanes at shift change, not a speech about your courage. Defeat War Machine Wrecker ×8 in War Machine Graveyard. Defeat War Machine Sentinel ×2 in War Machine Graveyard. Return to Quartermaster Rusk at Bastion Core to receive Supplyline Iron Writ and choose your Advance class.

objectives.description: Defeat War Machine Wrecker ×8 in War Machine Graveyard.
Defeat War Machine Sentinel ×2 in War Machine Graveyard.

quests.title: When the Forge Turns
quests.description: Our assembly guardians have classified their own crews as scrap. Production wants me to leave the line running. I have stopped it. Remove the hostile constructs before we restart. Expertise is knowing which pressure the system can bear, and when to shut it down. Defeat Titan Forge Automaton ×10 in Titan Assembly Yard. Defeat Titan Assembly Sentinel ×4 in Titan Assembly Yard. Return to Forge Inspector Maela at Bastion Core to receive Forge Control Crest and choose your Expert class.

objectives.description: Defeat Titan Forge Automaton ×10 in Titan Assembly Yard.
Defeat Titan Assembly Sentinel ×4 in Titan Assembly Yard.

quests.title: Command at Breaking Pressure
quests.description: The proto cores are rebuilding the defense lattice faster than we can isolate it. Cut down the sentinel screen and the cores. Then report to me personally. This command plate is not permission to spend lives carelessly. It is the obligation to bring the line through. Defeat Titan Assembly Sentinel ×16 in Titan Assembly Yard. Defeat Titan Proto Core ×6 in Titan Assembly Yard. Return to General Torren at Bastion Core to receive Bastion Command Plate and choose your Master class.

objectives.description: Defeat Titan Assembly Sentinel ×16 in Titan Assembly Yard.
Defeat Titan Proto Core ×6 in Titan Assembly Yard.

quests.title: A Favor with a Name
quests.description: You found my door. That saves us one test. Wetland crawlers have pinned a ferry crew on the wrong bank, and one of them owes me a very interesting story. Clear the passage. Come back to Port and we will discuss what you are good at. The favor will have your name on it. Defeat Swamp Crawler ×5 in Coral Wetlands. Return to Captain Vex at Port Meridian to receive Vex's Signed Passage and choose your Base class.

objectives.description: Defeat Swamp Crawler ×5 in Coral Wetlands.

quests.title: The Route Nobody Owns
quests.description: Everyone claims the jungle route when it is safe. Nobody claims the people stranded on it now. Remove the stalkers and contraband constructs. Keep our carriers moving, and I will give you the cipher to a network that remembers who helped it. Defeat Jungle Stalker ×8 in Smuggler Jungle. Defeat Contraband Golem ×2 in Smuggler Jungle. Return to Route Broker Lysa at Port Meridian to receive Unlisted Route Cipher and choose your Advance class.

objectives.description: Defeat Jungle Stalker ×8 in Smuggler Jungle.
Defeat Contraband Golem ×2 in Smuggler Jungle.

quests.title: Insurance Below the Waterline
quests.description: The divers' insurers would rather pay a death benefit than clear the submerged approach. I would rather have living divers. Break the guardians and behemoths blocking the ruins. Bring the report to Port. A guarantee should protect a person, not merely settle a ledger. Defeat Cradle Sentinel ×10 in Sunken Aethel Ruin. Defeat Aethel Behemoth ×4 in Sunken Aethel Ruin. Return to Diver Marshal Corin at Port Meridian to receive Deepwater Guarantee Seal and choose your Expert class.

objectives.description: Defeat Cradle Sentinel ×10 in Sunken Aethel Ruin.
Defeat Aethel Behemoth ×4 in Sunken Aethel Ruin.

quests.title: The Debt We Choose to Keep
quests.description: Our oldest contract allows us to walk away from the flooded route. We are staying. Push back the behemoths and leviathans so the last crews can surface. When I hand you the covenant coin, understand this: some debts are worth choosing, even when nobody can collect. Defeat Aethel Behemoth ×16 in Sunken Aethel Ruin. Defeat Sunken Aethel Leviathan ×6 in Sunken Aethel Ruin. Return to Keeper of Debts Sable at Port Meridian to receive Meridian Covenant Coin and choose your Master class.

objectives.description: Defeat Aethel Behemoth ×16 in Sunken Aethel Ruin.
Defeat Sunken Aethel Leviathan ×6 in Sunken Aethel Ruin.

quests.title: A Performance Worth Signing
quests.description: Your projection is promising. I do not certify projections. Rogue plateau drones are damaging a crew's survey equipment. Neutralize them and return to my office. The competency wafer requires a verifiable result. Once you have it, choose the discipline in which you intend to outperform your own baseline. Defeat Plateau Drone ×5 in Highland Plateau. Return to Director Astra Vey at The Spire to receive Astra's Competency Wafer and choose your Base class.

objectives.description: Defeat Plateau Drone ×5 in Highland Plateau.

quests.title: The Human Cost of Downtime
quests.description: Delta calls this an output problem. My maintenance crew calls it a survival problem. Remove the mining drones and their assault escort. I will sign your recovery license when the site is usable again. Efficient work gets people through their shift alive. Defeat Delta Mining Drone ×8 in Extraction Zone Delta. Defeat Delta Assault Drone ×2 in Extraction Zone Delta. Return to Operations Lead Tessa Lin at The Spire to receive Delta Recovery License and choose your Advance class.

objectives.description: Defeat Delta Mining Drone ×8 in Extraction Zone Delta.
Defeat Delta Assault Drone ×2 in Extraction Zone Delta.

quests.title: Authority to Halt the Reactor
quests.description: You are being evaluated for override authority. The reactor's defense units are obstructing emergency access. Clear them. Do not confuse a green dashboard with a safe facility. An expert must be willing to stop a profitable process when its evidence no longer supports operation. Defeat Titan Assembly Drone ×10 in Skybridge Reactor. Defeat Titan Assembly Sentinel ×4 in Skybridge Reactor. Return to Chief Auditor Ren at The Spire to receive Reactor Override Key and choose your Expert class.

objectives.description: Defeat Titan Assembly Drone ×10 in Skybridge Reactor.
Defeat Titan Assembly Sentinel ×4 in Skybridge Reactor.

quests.title: The Liability We Will Not Export
quests.description: The board suggests exporting the failing cores. That would export the casualties as well. Contain the sentinel units and proto cores here, on our own ground. Return with the record. This mandate will give you authority, and a liability you may never hide in somebody else's account. Defeat Titan Assembly Sentinel ×16 in Skybridge Reactor. Defeat Titan Proto Core ×6 in Skybridge Reactor. Return to Executive Director Iona Hale at The Spire to receive OmniCorp Executive Mandate and choose your Master class.

objectives.description: Defeat Titan Assembly Sentinel ×16 in Skybridge Reactor.
Defeat Titan Proto Core ×6 in Skybridge Reactor.

quests.title: Listen Before You Wield
quests.description: Power does not make the forest yours. Listen first. The barklings have turned on the paths used by our seed keepers. Still their violence and return to the Sanctum. I will entrust you with a listening shard. The calling you choose must leave room for voices other than your own. Defeat Forest Barkling ×5 in Glowvine Forest. Return to Oracle Seraphel at Sanctum to receive Listening Shard and choose your Base class.

objectives.description: Defeat Forest Barkling ×5 in Glowvine Forest.

quests.title: The Root Remembers
quests.description: The swamp remembers every wound, but memory alone cannot shelter a traveler. Creepers and titans now hold the root paths. Open them for the caretakers. Bring your account back to me; I will help you hear what survival has changed in you. Defeat Shardroot Creeper ×8 in Shardroot Swamp. Defeat Shardroot Titan ×2 in Shardroot Swamp. Return to Root Listener Amara at Sanctum to receive Rootmemory Votive and choose your Advance class.

objectives.description: Defeat Shardroot Creeper ×8 in Shardroot Swamp.
Defeat Shardroot Titan ×2 in Shardroot Swamp.

quests.title: The Wound Beneath the Altar
quests.description: The altar's defenders strike at the people trying to mend it. Some call that a holy judgment. I call it another wound. End the hostile guardians' hold over the approach. Return to Sanctum. I need a witness who sees suffering clearly, even when it contradicts a comforting story. Defeat Titan Forge Automaton ×10 in Heartwood Altar. Defeat Aethel Behemoth ×4 in Heartwood Altar. Return to Woundkeeper Oriel at Sanctum to receive Heartwood Witness Stone and choose your Expert class.

objectives.description: Defeat Titan Forge Automaton ×10 in Heartwood Altar.
Defeat Aethel Behemoth ×4 in Heartwood Altar.

quests.title: A Vow for Those Who Follow
quests.description: We will leave this altar to children who did not make its scars. Push back the beasts keeping our keepers outside. Do not offer me a claim of divine favor. Offer them a place they can enter safely. That is the vow this reliquary will hold. Defeat Aethel Behemoth ×16 in Heartwood Altar. Defeat Sunken Aethel Leviathan ×6 in Heartwood Altar. Return to Elder Naeva at Sanctum to receive Sanctum Keeper Reliquary and choose your Master class.

objectives.description: Defeat Aethel Behemoth ×16 in Heartwood Altar.
Defeat Sunken Aethel Leviathan ×6 in Heartwood Altar.

quests.title: A Place in the Formation
quests.description: Stand here, where I can see your footing. The dune scavengers are threatening our water runners. Clear the outskirts, then return to the fortress. I train people for a place in the formation, not a lonely death in the sand. Earn your knot, and we will choose how you serve beside us. Defeat Dune Scavenger ×5 in Dune Outskirts. Return to Centurion Valka at Fortress Kaelen to receive Valka's Formation Knot and choose your Base class.

objectives.description: Defeat Dune Scavenger ×5 in Dune Outskirts.

quests.title: The Standard Does Not Walk Alone
quests.description: The standard is useless if nobody makes it through the badlands beneath it. Ash hounds and brutes are harrying our march. Clear them and report to the fortress. I will judge your advance by the ground the next formation can safely cross. Defeat Ash Hound ×8 in Scorched Badlands. Defeat Badland Brute ×2 in Scorched Badlands. Return to Marchwarden Sera at Fortress Kaelen to receive Marchwarden Standard Tab and choose your Advance class.

objectives.description: Defeat Ash Hound ×8 in Scorched Badlands.
Defeat Badland Brute ×2 in Scorched Badlands.

quests.title: Names Before Numbers
quests.description: Every empty place in formation has a name. The canyon's machines are making more of them. Clear the drone ranks and their sentinels. Bring the record back. An expert sees a missing fighter before they see a convenient gap in the roster. Defeat Titan Assembly Drone ×10 in Forge Canyon Depths. Defeat Titan Assembly Sentinel ×4 in Forge Canyon Depths. Return to Rollkeeper Bren at Fortress Kaelen to receive Rollkeeper Steel Token and choose your Expert class.

objectives.description: Defeat Titan Assembly Drone ×10 in Forge Canyon Depths.
Defeat Titan Assembly Sentinel ×4 in Forge Canyon Depths.

quests.title: A Home Beyond the March
quests.description: Our elders promised a home beyond the march. It cannot be a fortress that devours its builders. Break the sentinels and proto cores controlling the canyon approach. Return to Kaelen. Carry this hearth standard as a duty to the living, as well as to the names we remember. Defeat Titan Assembly Sentinel ×16 in Forge Canyon Depths. Defeat Titan Proto Core ×6 in Forge Canyon Depths. Return to Legate Ashra at Fortress Kaelen to receive Starforged Hearth Standard and choose your Master class.

objectives.description: Defeat Titan Assembly Sentinel ×16 in Forge Canyon Depths.
Defeat Titan Proto Core ×6 in Forge Canyon Depths.

items.name: Civic Oath Seal
items.description: The ration crews are moving again. You held the line without forgetting who stood behind it. Issued by Instructor Kael as proof of the Base trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Routekeeper Warrant
items.description: The route is open. I can assign crews to it, rather than merely drawing it on a map. Issued by Field Captain Ilyra as proof of the Advance trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Cradle Stabilization Charter
items.description: Your report is sound. The protocol can now be rewritten around what actually happened. Issued by Inspector Soren as proof of the Expert trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Concordium Steward Sigil
items.description: Every name on my list has a route out. This sigil carries their trust, not just my signature. Issued by Marshal Elian as proof of the Master trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Resonance Thesis Prism
items.description: An honest record, including uncertainty. That is a better beginning than a spectacular claim. Issued by Archsage Myr as proof of the Base trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Echo Calibration Lens
items.description: The baseline holds. We can enter those caverns with a reasoned plan rather than a wish. Issued by Resonant Scholar Eira as proof of the Advance trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Peer Witness Crystal
items.description: Your evidence survives scrutiny. The witness crystal certifies the work, not infallibility. Issued by Examiner Thalen as proof of the Expert trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Arcanum Living Codex
items.description: The expedition has returned. This codex remains open: your mastery includes admitting what we still do not know. Issued by First Archivist Neris as proof of the Master trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Tempered Service Rivet
items.description: The recovery lanes are usable. Good. That rivet was tempered in work, not ceremony. Issued by War Marshal Drax as proof of the Base trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Supplyline Iron Writ
items.description: Supplies are moving. The crews will notice your result before they ever learn your rank. Issued by Quartermaster Rusk as proof of the Advance trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Forge Control Crest
items.description: The shutdown held. You chose the crews over a pleasing output figure. Issued by Forge Inspector Maela as proof of the Expert trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Bastion Command Plate
items.description: The lattice is under our control. Take the plate, and remember exactly what command costs. Issued by General Torren as proof of the Master trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Vex's Signed Passage
items.description: The ferry crew is safe. A useful favor, and a signature I will remember. Issued by Captain Vex as proof of the Base trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Unlisted Route Cipher

items.description: The divers came back breathing. That is a guarantee I am willing to sign. Issued by Diver Marshal Corin as proof of the Expert trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Meridian Covenant Coin
items.description: No one was left below. Keep the coin. It is a promise with witnesses, not loose currency. Issued by Keeper of Debts Sable as proof of the Master trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Delta Recovery License
items.description: The crew has safe access. That is the recovery figure I am filing. Issued by Operations Lead Tessa Lin as proof of the Advance trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Reactor Override Key

items.name: OmniCorp Executive Mandate
items.description: The failure was contained here. Your mandate records a decision we are prepared to stand behind. Issued by Executive Director Iona Hale as proof of the Master trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Listening Shard
items.description: The seed keepers can pass. Hold the shard gently; learning to listen has only begun. Issued by Oracle Seraphel as proof of the Base trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Rootmemory Votive
items.description: The root paths are open. Your votive remembers the people who can use them again. Issued by Root Listener Amara as proof of the Advance trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Heartwood Witness Stone
items.description: You named the wound and made room to mend it. The witness stone carries that truth. Issued by Woundkeeper Oriel as proof of the Expert trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Sanctum Keeper Reliquary
items.description: Those who follow us will have a safe approach. The reliquary holds your vow to keep listening. Issued by Elder Naeva as proof of the Master trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Valka's Formation Knot
items.description: The water runners are back. Tie the knot yourself. You have a place beside us. Issued by Centurion Valka as proof of the Base trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

items.name: Marchwarden Standard Tab

items.name: Rollkeeper Steel Token

items.name: Starforged Hearth Standard

npcs.name: Instructor Kael
npcs.title: Concordium Combat Trainer
npcs.description: Instructor Kael teaches Concordium combat doctrines and class advancement to qualified recruits.
npcs.greeting: Advancement requires preparation. Let's assess where you stand.

npcs.name: Field Captain Ilyra
npcs.title: Advance Class Mentor
npcs.description: Kael taught you to hold a line. I need you to move one. The outer-ring wardens are driving supply crews back into the broken quarter. Clear a passage without treating every ruin as expendable. A specialist earns trust when the next crew can follow them home.
npcs.greeting: Kael taught you to hold a line.

npcs.name: Inspector Soren
npcs.title: Expert Class Mentor
npcs.description: The stabilization protocol assumes obedient sentinels. Our sentinels have stopped obeying. I need evidence that you can respond when the procedure fails: remove the hostile units inside the exclusion zone. Report what the ledger records, not what you wish happened.
npcs.greeting: The stabilization protocol assumes obedient sentinels.

npcs.name: Marshal Elian
npcs.title: Master Class Mentor
npcs.description: There is one convoy left inside the exclusion zone. Command calls the route unrecoverable. I have their names here. Break the beasts controlling that corridor and bring your report to me. Mastery means accepting responsibility when the easy order is to abandon people.
npcs.greeting: There is one convoy left inside the exclusion zone.

npcs.name: Archsage Myr
npcs.title: Arcanum Discipline Mentor
npcs.description: Archsage Myr guides Arcanum class advancement with esoteric methods that produce undeniable results.
npcs.greeting: Your path is written in resonance. I help you read it.

npcs.name: Resonant Scholar Eira
npcs.title: Advance Class Mentor
npcs.description: The cavern echoes have begun answering signals nobody transmitted. My last team withdrew, correctly. Establish a safe baseline against the bats and the resonant echoes before I send anyone back. Curiosity should widen our understanding, not empty our chairs.
npcs.greeting: The cavern echoes have begun answering signals nobody transmitted.

npcs.name: Examiner Thalen
npcs.title: Expert Class Mentor
npcs.description: The peak guardians respond differently to each pulse. Your task is not to declare them understood; it is to stop the hostile pattern long enough for our instruments to survive. Bring a complete field record. I will challenge every conclusion you cannot support.
npcs.greeting: The peak guardians respond differently to each pulse.

npcs.name: First Archivist Neris
npcs.title: Master Class Mentor
npcs.description: We could publish a triumph by sacrificing the next expedition. I refuse. Contain the peak's guardians and tyrants so that discovery can continue without another missing team. A master leaves knowledge others can test, and a path by which they can return.
npcs.greeting: We could publish a triumph by sacrificing the next expedition.

npcs.name: War Marshal Drax
npcs.title: Iron Hegemony War Instructor
npcs.description: War Marshal Drax has produced more elite soldiers than any trainer in Hegemony history. He is not gentle about it.
npcs.greeting: You want advancement? Show me you've earned the right to ask for it.

npcs.name: Quartermaster Rusk
npcs.title: Advance Class Mentor
npcs.description: A brilliant fighter with an empty supply wagon is an expensive corpse. The graveyard machines are stopping our salvage crews. Clear the wreckers and their sentinel escorts. I want usable lanes at shift change, not a speech about your courage.
npcs.greeting: A brilliant fighter with an empty supply wagon is an expensive corpse.

npcs.name: Forge Inspector Maela
npcs.title: Expert Class Mentor
npcs.description: Our assembly guardians have classified their own crews as scrap. Production wants me to leave the line running. I have stopped it. Remove the hostile constructs before we restart. Expertise is knowing which pressure the system can bear, and when to shut it down.
npcs.greeting: Our assembly guardians have classified their own crews as scrap.

npcs.name: General Torren
npcs.title: Master Class Mentor
npcs.description: The proto cores are rebuilding the defense lattice faster than we can isolate it. Cut down the sentinel screen and the cores. Then report to me personally. This command plate is not permission to spend lives carelessly. It is the obligation to bring the line through.
npcs.greeting: The proto cores are rebuilding the defense lattice faster than we can isolate it.

npcs.name: Captain Vex
npcs.title: Cartel Combat Broker
npcs.description: Captain Vex trains Cartel operatives in infiltration and combat. The facility doesn't officially exist.
npcs.greeting: You found this place. That's already the first test. You passed.

npcs.name: Route Broker Lysa
npcs.title: Advance Class Mentor
npcs.description: Everyone claims the jungle route when it is safe. Nobody claims the people stranded on it now. Remove the stalkers and contraband constructs. Keep our carriers moving, and I will give you the cipher to a network that remembers who helped it.
npcs.greeting: Everyone claims the jungle route when it is safe.

npcs.name: Diver Marshal Corin
npcs.title: Expert Class Mentor
npcs.description: The divers' insurers would rather pay a death benefit than clear the submerged approach. I would rather have living divers. Break the guardians and behemoths blocking the ruins. Bring the report to Port. A guarantee should protect a person, not merely settle a ledger.
npcs.greeting: The divers' insurers would rather pay a death benefit than clear the submerged approach.

npcs.name: Keeper of Debts Sable
npcs.title: Master Class Mentor
npcs.description: Our oldest contract allows us to walk away from the flooded route. We are staying. Push back the behemoths and leviathans so the last crews can surface. When I hand you the covenant coin, understand this: some debts are worth choosing, even when nobody can collect.
npcs.greeting: Our oldest contract allows us to walk away from the flooded route.

npcs.name: Director Astra Vey
npcs.title: OmniCorp Combat Systems Instructor
npcs.description: Director Astra Vey manages OmniCorp's elite class programme with corporate KPIs and genuine tactical brilliance.
npcs.greeting: OmniCorp class advancement is metric-based. Your last performance determined your eligibility.

npcs.name: Operations Lead Tessa Lin
npcs.title: Advance Class Mentor
npcs.description: Delta calls this an output problem. My maintenance crew calls it a survival problem. Remove the mining drones and their assault escort. I will sign your recovery license when the site is usable again. Efficient work gets people through their shift alive.
npcs.greeting: Delta calls this an output problem.

npcs.name: Chief Auditor Ren
npcs.title: Expert Class Mentor
npcs.description: You are being evaluated for override authority. The reactor's defense units are obstructing emergency access. Clear them. Do not confuse a green dashboard with a safe facility. An expert must be willing to stop a profitable process when its evidence no longer supports operation.
npcs.greeting: You are being evaluated for override authority.

npcs.name: Executive Director Iona Hale
npcs.title: Master Class Mentor
npcs.description: The board suggests exporting the failing cores. That would export the casualties as well. Contain the sentinel units and proto cores here, on our own ground. Return with the record. This mandate will give you authority, and a liability you may never hide in somebody else's account.
npcs.greeting: The board suggests exporting the failing cores.

npcs.name: Oracle Seraphel
npcs.title: Shard Ascension Guide
npcs.description: Oracle Seraphel channels Shard energy to unlock class potential. Sessions are intense and leave participants changed.
npcs.greeting: The Shard does not grant power cheaply. Are you prepared to pay its price?

npcs.name: Root Listener Amara
npcs.title: Advance Class Mentor
npcs.description: The swamp remembers every wound, but memory alone cannot shelter a traveler. Creepers and titans now hold the root paths. Open them for the caretakers. Bring your account back to me; I will help you hear what survival has changed in you.
npcs.greeting: The swamp remembers every wound, but memory alone cannot shelter a traveler.

npcs.name: Woundkeeper Oriel
npcs.title: Expert Class Mentor
npcs.description: The altar's defenders strike at the people trying to mend it. Some call that a holy judgment. I call it another wound. End the hostile guardians' hold over the approach. Return to Sanctum. I need a witness who sees suffering clearly, even when it contradicts a comforting story.
npcs.greeting: The altar's defenders strike at the people trying to mend it.

npcs.name: Elder Naeva
npcs.title: Master Class Mentor
npcs.description: We will leave this altar to children who did not make its scars. Push back the beasts keeping our keepers outside. Do not offer me a claim of divine favor. Offer them a place they can enter safely. That is the vow this reliquary will hold.
npcs.greeting: We will leave this altar to children who did not make its scars.

npcs.name: Centurion Valka
npcs.title: Legion Combat Drillmaster
npcs.description: Centurion Valka trains Legion fighters in the ancient combat traditions. Advancement means surviving her drills.
npcs.greeting: Legion advancement is earned in combat. Step onto the sand.

npcs.name: Marchwarden Sera
npcs.title: Advance Class Mentor
npcs.description: The standard is useless if nobody makes it through the badlands beneath it. Ash hounds and brutes are harrying our march. Clear them and report to the fortress. I will judge your advance by the ground the next formation can safely cross.
npcs.greeting: The standard is useless if nobody makes it through the badlands beneath it.

npcs.name: Rollkeeper Bren
npcs.title: Expert Class Mentor
npcs.description: Every empty place in formation has a name. The canyon's machines are making more of them. Clear the drone ranks and their sentinels. Bring the record back. An expert sees a missing fighter before they see a convenient gap in the roster.
npcs.greeting: Every empty place in formation has a name.

npcs.name: Legate Ashra
npcs.title: Master Class Mentor
npcs.description: Our elders promised a home beyond the march. It cannot be a fortress that devours its builders. Break the sentinels and proto cores controlling the canyon approach. Return to Kaelen. Carry this hearth standard as a duty to the living, as well as to the names we remember.
npcs.greeting: Our elders promised a home beyond the march.
